康敏苏.definition:
康敏苏 is a [Homophonic] of Coming soon in Chinese ，however ，[Lady GaGa] only！
Because Lady GaGa always said that her album ARTPOP second singles DO WHAT U WANT MV Coming Soon but has not Coming，therefore GaGa had 康敏苏 as a [Homophonic] nickname in China.
（因为Lady GaGa说过专辑ARTPOP里第二张单曲DO WHAT U WANT的MV很快播出，总说Coming Soon可是一直没Coming，因此GaGa在中国也因此多了康敏苏这个谐音外号 ）
康敏苏.example: [Lady GaGa] [formerly] known as Stefani Joanne [Angelina] Germanotta ， Also known 康敏苏 or 土婆（鳖鳖） in China
